environment.description: Node.js Apollo GraphQL service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with a standard HTTPS listener (TLS termination at ALB, no client certificate requirement). The ALB target group forwards traffic on port 4000. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to the ALB. No WAF rules attached. The LDAP directory is reachable from the container via VPC internal DNS.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS:443 listener, ACM certificate, no mutual TLS
config.security_groups: ALB SG: inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0; Task SG: inbound 4000/tcp from ALB SG
config.network: Private subnet, LDAP server at directory.internal:389 reachable via VPC DNS
config.authentication: none - service trusts all forwarded traffic
